parts.title: Create a route for shared learning
parts.body: Champions and office hours help teams share evaluated patterns, failed experiments, and practical constraints. Keep a searchable library of use cases with owners, approval status, reusable prompts or components, and evidence. Reward reporting an issue early. Do not turn informal champions into an unaccountable approval chain.
parts.label: Understand

parts.title: Run a monthly clinic
parts.body: Ask one team to present a successful workflow and one to present a failure. Require the baseline, evaluation result, user feedback, and next decision from both. Publish reusable lessons with names and dates, then revisit whether another team actually adopted them.
parts.label: Apply
